name: web-isometric-tilted-dark-orange-ai-writing-ui-wall
title: Isometric wall of dark AI-writing screens separated by orange grout lines
whatItIs: A field of black rounded UI screens rotated in isometric perspective and tiled with orange gaps: hero 'Write Faster with AI' with dotted hands, feature cards, tone controls, pain quotes and step flows with orange buttons.
whatItMeans: Powerful and immersive; the tiled wall shows the whole site as an environment.
techniques: Use orange as grout between panels.
Keep UI dark with orange buttons.

vocabulary.definition: A composite showing many pages at once.
Orange used for buttons on dark UI.
